description: This file implements a Zephyr driver for an Ethernet interface using shared memory (ivshmem) for virtualization, including initialization, state management, packet transmission and reception, and thread handling.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_get_stats
methods.description: Returns the Ethernet statistics structure for the device.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_start
methods.description: Enables the device and signals the thread to check/update state.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_stop
methods.description: Disables the device and signals the thread to check/update state.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_caps
methods.description: Returns the hardware capabilities of the device.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_send
methods.description: Handles sending a network packet via shared memory.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_rx
methods.description: Receives a network packet from shared memory.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_set_state
methods.description: Updates the device and shared memory state.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_state_update
methods.description: Updates device state based on peer state and internal conditions.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_thread
methods.description: Main thread loop handling state updates and packet processing.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the device, sets up shared memory, registers handlers, creates thread, and configures MAC address.

methods.name: eth_ivshmem_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address, and manages link state.
